title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.30844v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. translated_title: DyLoMo-DiT：动态循环混合专家扩散Transformer
translated_abstract: 扩散Transformer（DiT）通过同时增加参数量和计算量来扩展模型容量。混合专家变体在保持每个token计算量大致固定的情况下扩展了参数容量，但仍需要大量的参数存储空间。本文提出了动态循环MoE DiT（DyLoMo-DiT），它复用参数而非增加参数：通过权重共享的循环反复应用中间层，同时利用稀疏专家在各个token之间分配参数容量。这种设计在不增加参数的情况下加深了网络，从而将参数预算释放出来用于其他用途，例如更多的专家或更多样化的层。该方法还能动态分配计算量，根据噪声水平改变循环遍历的次数。实验表明，DyLoMo-DiT能够更有效地利用参数和计算预算，将更多的循环次数分配给低噪声步骤可获得进一步的性能提升。在ImageNet 256×256数据集上，DyLoMo-DiT降低了FID（原文摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: DyLoMo-DiT通过权重共享循环复用中间层参数并结合稀疏混合专家机制，在不增加参数的情况下加深网络，并根据噪声水平动态调整计算量，从而更高效地利用参数和计算预算。
en_tdlr: DyLoMo-DiT deepens diffusion transformers without adding parameters by reusing middle layers through a weight-shared loop combined with sparse mixture-of-experts, dynamically allocating computation across noise levels for more efficient use of parameter and compute budgets.
